prompt:
Use-case: ui-mockup. Generate one fully designed, high-fidelity MOBILE WEB screenshot, portrait 390:844 aspect ratio, sharp at high resolution. Flat front-on UI artwork only, edge to edge, no phone device, browser chrome, perspective, desktop inset, multiple panels, mood board or poster. This is a real usable Korean stock ranking service called exactly “천하제일 단타대회”. It is for casual individual investors arriving from Google/Naver to immediately check and browse ALL stock rankings and download CSV for Excel. The ranking IS the first-screen content. Do not create a marketing hero, trading terminal, investing advice, buy/sell controls, competitions, game points, trophies, portfolio/account, subscriptions or new financial capabilities.

REFERENCE: attached local reference image is ONLY the existing brand symbol: round golden-yellow disk with one red five-point star and a bold black outline. Keep its identity. The wordmark should be an art-directed retro Korean brush/ink lettering lockup using red for “천하제일”, golden yellow for “단타대회”, dark outline, legible full name. Make it tasteful and compact (not default outlined serif). Body copy is crisp modern Korean sans-serif. Tabular numbers. No pixel-font body text, CRT noise, neon, gradients, glass, gigantic floating cards, rainbow company avatars, stars added to stock values, or decorative cartoons in the working content.

SAME CORE INFORMATION FOR FAIR COMPARISON:
Top compact brand lockup with the full name, very small subtitle “주식 지표와 전체 순위”.
Large accessible search field “기업·종목 검색”.
Navigation “랭킹” and “최근 본”; metric controls “시가총액”, “PER”, “PBR”, “배당” (overflow acknowledged for more metrics).
An actual h1 “시가총액 순위” followed by scope “기업 합산” and quiet “2025.09.22 기준 · 예시 데이터”.
CSV action “CSV 다운로드” with nearby microcopy “엑셀에서 열 수 있어요”.
A continuous, aligned, vertically scrollable ranking list, with column meaning clear: “순위”, “기업”, “시가총액”, “등락”. This screen represents the start of the full ranking, not a decorative top-5 collection.
Rows with representative EXAMPLE content: 1 삼성전자 / 005930 / 549조 / 0.00%; 2 SK하이닉스 / 000660 / 256조 / +0.44%; 3 LG에너지솔루션 / 373220 / 82조 / +2.91%; 4 삼성바이오로직스 / 207940 / 73조 / -4.51%; 5 현대차 / 005380 / 55조 / -0.72%; 6 한화에어로스페이스 / 012450 / 53조 / +3.68%. Can include only the rows that fit naturally.
Prices are not necessary. Show a discreet miniature 30-day sparkline under each main value if the structure has room; never let charts reduce the legibility of names and market cap.
Do not truncate most company names; the long name 삼성바이오로직스 must fit.
An understated bottom continuation “전체 2,601개 기업 · 1–20위” plus “다음 20개 →”; represents a full list with successive pages. Keep the continuation inside the image and unambiguous.
No duplicated home/chart/profile bottom navigation. An optional compact bottom rail can only show “랭킹”, “검색”, “최근 본”.
Korean data convention: positive change red #C63232, negative change blue #2866AD, zero neutral. Brand gold is reserved for selected controls and brand. Market cap itself is neutral, not painted red as if it increased.
The layout must feel finished, precise, plausible to implement, designed for reading and touch. Main rows at least 52px logical high, text comfortable at mobile size, controls 44px where possible. Keep sufficient contrast. Include no claim of real-time/live data. This is a conceptual visual proposal, not an actual production screenshot.

DIRECTION A: “황금 전광판”. STRUCTURE FIRST: compact narrow masthead at top; below it a gold-edged inset search bar; a clearly selected gold metric tab; a small crisp ranking heading/scope/date cluster; one uninterrupted DARK SCOREBOARD table extending most of the viewport; understated CSV control near title; quiet pagination footer. Make the board a coherent single dark surface, not a pile of cards. Full name lockup small but unmistakable. Matt carbon #181A1C, secondary #25282A, warm white #F5F5EF, gold #F8AD02. Palette belongs to a vintage arcade high-score scoreboard and precision sports display translated into modern mobile UI, with no literal LED dots or gamer motifs. Header and list use solid material, restrained 1px rules, minimal corners, and meticulously aligned ranks and values. Gold for current metric, subtle ranking numeral detail; a premium clean instrument face. Red positive and blue negative remain distinct and legible against dark. No chart-dominated layout. Light signature: selected metric has a short brass-colored underline, not a big pill; rank transitions could slide along the same rail. Header under 70px logical, search 48px, tabs under 50px, so at least 5 full ranking rows fit. Distinct from a typical navy SaaS dashboard; dark charcoal and warm sports identity.
